France–China BIT (1994, remains relevant for Chinese investors)
France–United States FTA/TIFA framework (not a full BIT, but investment facilitation provisions apply)
France–Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
EU–Japan EPA (with investment protection provisions applicable to French overseas trade)
France–OECD Multilateral Mutual Administrative Assistance Convention

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 et seq., R.561-1 et seq., L.561-45, R.561-55 (TRACFIN); Code de commerce, Articles L.123-3, L.123-6, L.123-7, R.123-220-1 to R.123-220-6 (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs, RBE); Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5AMLD); Directive (EU) 2019/1153 (cross-border access to financial information); French Monetary and Financial Code implementing Order No. 2020-115 of 12 February 2020; National Regulation No. 2020-05 of the French Financial Markets Authority (AMF); French Criminal Code Article 324-1 et seq. (money laundering prevention).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the articles of association of any corporate shareholder (extrait K-bis or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) via Greffe du tribunal de commerce in France, or the competent company registry in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the shareholder is incorporated in an Apostille Convention country) or Consular Legalization by the French Embassy/Consulate in the shareholder's country (if not an Apostille country)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity card copy of each direct shareholder, manager (gérant), and ultimate beneficial owner (individual)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, passport office, or civil registry authority of the individual's state of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of the underlying identity document, plus certified French translation by a sworn translator for non-French documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 3 months) for each UBO and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider (electricity, water, internet), municipal authority, or regulated bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille normally required for simple utility address proof; however, if challenges arise, notarized translation or consular attestation may be sought. For countries outside the Apostille Convention, Consular Legalization of the issuing to the French authorities is mandatory if the registry insists.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / excerpt of the corporate register (extrait du registre) of the direct shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if applicable) or Consular Legalization via the French Embassy of the shareholder's country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration form (Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) required by R.123-220-1 of the French Code de commerce
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The founders/legal representative of the SARL, certified by the manager(s) and notarized where a notary is involved; ancillary evidence includes proof of shareholding structure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: In-country execution before a French notary (if statute made by authentic act) or filed directly through Guichet unique with no apostille if all underlying supporting UBO documents are already legalized/apostilled as per the bundle items above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming adequacy of funds for share capital subscription (where share capital is not fully deposited before incorporation, or for proof of source of wealth of UBO for high-risk PEP status)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or financial institution holding the funds, addressed to the French registrar or the notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of the issuing bank's signature if the bank letter is foreign and accepted as a notarial/legalized exhibit; otherwise, direct original signed copy plus bank confirmation — accepted by the GFE through its IT systems

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of apostille (formerly legalizzazione) for any non-French power of attorney appointing the manager or a representative to sign the incorporation deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or designated authority in the country issuing the power of attorney, then French consulate legalization/auth at the French Embassy if the country is not party to the Apostille Convention
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Double-legalization path: (i) Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin; (ii) French Consular Legalization at the Embassy/Consulate of France in that country. If that country is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, only the apostille of the jurisdiction's MFA is necessary.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all natural persons identified as beneficial owners, directors, and senior managers against: (i) French TRACFIN PEP database; (ii) OFAC SDN List (U.S. Treasury); (iii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iv) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (European External Action Service); (v) EU Asset Freeze and Financial Restrictive Measures; (vi) French national freezing measures (arrêtés du Ministre de l'Économie). Ongoing screening on a tri-monthly basis for the life of the business relationship, with enhanced due diligence (EDD) required for PEPs, family members, and known close associates; risk-based approach codified under French AML/CFT obligations and French AMF General Regulation and CNCC guidance. Any match or hit triggers immediate dematerialized suspension of the incorporation procedure and declaration to TRACFIN within 48 hours.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (géré par l'INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, with name clearance checks against the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and Infogreffe (RCS databases)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be in French or transliterated into Latin alphabetical characters; use of non-Latin scripts (Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, etc.) is not permitted in the registered name. The name must include the legal form 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' either as a suffix or as part of the full name. Names must comply with the principle of 'dénomination sociale', must not incorporate trade names or trademarks causing confusion, and must be written in comprehensible Latin alphabet letters without unusual symbols except accepted punctuation, hyphens, and numerals. Where a foreign brand name is used, it must be accompanied by a Latin-alphabet declaration of transliteration in the statutes.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Banquier, Crédit, Établissement financier (requiring ACPR authorization)
Assurance, Mutuelle, Réassurance (requiring insurance regulatory authorization)
France, République, État, National, Ministère, Gouvernement (when implying state affiliation)
Président, Maire, Préfet (when used to imply office or competence)
Nobel, Croix-Rouge, Red Cross, United Nations, ONU, UNESCO, OECD (protected international emblems and institutions)
Musée, Université, Académie (if the company is not actually a recognized educational/cultural institution)
Avocat, Notaire, Huissier (reserved professional terms for regulated legal professions)
Médical, Pharmacie, Laboratoire (regulated health-sector terms requiring professional registration)
Trust, Fiducie, Hedge Fund, OPCVM, SICAV (professional investment vehicle terms prohibited)
Monnaie, Bitcoin, Crypto (subject to AMF/ACPR level Saut de Régulation under PACTE law and requiring special regime approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In case of rejection by the Guichet unique within the 30-day window, the applicant must file an administrative appeal (réclamation administrative préalable) with the INPI through the same portal within 15 days, specifying the grounds of refusal, and annexing proof of prior trademark rights, prior authorization of the relevant authority, or any conflict-resolution agreement. If the INPI upholds the refusal, an appeal must be filed before the Administrative Court of Paris within 2 months of the express rejection notice; absent express notice, the applicant may also apply to the President of the Tribunal judiciaire for an order compelling the registry to accept the name. If refusal is due to a trademark conflict, the applicant may also initiate a cancellation action before the Cour d'appel against the prior trademark owner, but the incorporation can be completed under a trailed name while the appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully remote/virtual offices are permissible for SARL registration as the registered office (siège social) can be established at the residence of the manager or at a third-party domiciliation company (centre de domiciliation) that is formally approved and holds an authorization issued by the prefecture or chamber of commerce, provided the domiciliation agreement is in writing and the office has a physical address in France. Virtual offices using only a virtual street address without any actual leased space are invalid for this industry; the location must be capable of receiving mail and official court notifications. A flexible coworking-space address may be used if the provider has the legal license to domicile companies; however, the tax authorities may require actual substance for benefit from domestic corporate tax residence, and the DGFiP may scrutinize whether the business has a stable establishment for VAT and customs purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: MODERATE (23% probability): Unannounced physical verification visits may be conducted by the Chamber of Commerce (Greffe) or the CRI (Centre de Formalités des Entreprises) for random verification of existence within the first 18 months; the likelihood increases to 50% if inconsistent UBO declarations or difficulty reaching the registered address are detected. The DGFiP (French tax authority) generally inspects VAT registration and amalgamation risks through documentation, but a dedicated anti-abuse check (per Article L.45 B LPF) can lead to an on-site visit where nominal domiciliation is suspected.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general company provisions), and L.123-36 (single electronic filing window); implementing decree R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office department; filings centralized through the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'une personne morale / Fiche d'immatriculation au Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (Form M0) together with the Statuts constitutifs and all statutory exhibits.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum nominal capital (metadata minimum_capital_requirement=false). Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and paid up; they must be blocked on a French bank account or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and released only upon RCS registration (Articles L.223-7 and L.223-8). In-kind contributions must be fully paid at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. The initial share capital of the Company is hereby subscribed and allotted to the founding shareholders as set out in the Articles; 2. The registered office is established at the address stated in the Articles effective upon registration; 3. [Insert Name] is appointed sole Gérant with full powers to act on behalf of the Company; 4. The Gérant is authorized to deposit the capital, publish the legal notice, open bank accounts, and file the incorporation dossier; 5. All pre-incorporation acts performed for the benefit of the Company are hereby approved and ratified. Passed unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Articles of Association Drafting, Partner Approval and Gérant Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company counsel or notary, with advance name-availability check through the INPI database and the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare draft statuts of the SARL under Article L.223-1 et seq., covering share allocation, foreign-shareholder eligibility, registered office, corporate purpose (ISIC 3240 wooden puzzle manufacturing), and the number and powers of the Gérant. Obtain signatures of all shareholders and verify name availability via the national trademark and company-name registers.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts (French or bilingual)
Identity documents (passport/ID) of each shareholder and Gérant
Proof of address of each shareholder
Déclaration de non-condamnation of the Gérant
INPI name-availability/verification record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen corporate name conflicts with existing INPI marks, revise the statuts and re-verify; remediate any statutory content defects before execution to avoid registration refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit and Blocking of Cash Capital Contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional company account and deposit the subscribed cash capital in accordance with Articles L.223-7 and L.223-8. Obtain the attestation du dépôt des fonds issued by the depository institution; the funds remain blocked until the company is registered and the K-bis extract is issued.
required_dossiers: Provisional statuts or a certified extract
Identity documents of the representative opening the account
Capital subscription payment records
Attestation de dépôt de fonds (blocking certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the beneficial-ownership documentation under French KYC rules, supplement with a structure chart of direct and indirect shareholders; no capital may be released before RCS registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Mandatory Statutory Notice in a Legal Announcements Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal publications (journaux d'annonces légales) accredited by the Préfecture of the registered office department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and submit the avis de constitution stating the exact company name, corporate form (SARL), share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, term, Gérant identity, and RCS filing city. Obtain the attestation de parution to attach to the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: Signed notice text prepared by the Gérant
Copy of the statuts
Proof of payment of publication fees
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette requires corrections due to inconsistency between the notice and the statuts, publish a corrective notice (avis rectificatif) and obtain the corrected attestation before submission to the Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Dossier via the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (www.guichet-entreprises.fr) administered by INPI; forward transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, URSSAF and DGFiP.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form M0 online, select the legal form SARL and the appropriate activity code, attach all required dossiers, certify the truthfulness of the declaration, and pay the official filing fees. The registry completes RCS registration and issues the SIREN/SIRET/APE codes automatically; download the K-bis extract once registration is confirmed.
required_dossiers: Completed Form M0 (déclaration de création)
Legible copy of the statuts dated and signed by all shareholders
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital blocking)
Attestation de parution of the legal notice
Proof of registered-office rights (lease, title or free-occupation attestation)
Declaration of the beneficial owner (bénéficiaire effectif)
Identity documents and Gérant declaration of no convictions
Power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is placed in 'en attente de pièces' status or rejected, remedy the stated deficiencies through the Guichet Unique messaging before the statutory cure period expires; upon implicit refusal or undue delay, petition the judge supervising the RCS or the President of the Tribunal de Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Administrative Activation and K-bis Collection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, DGFiP and URSSAF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, download the official K-bis extract as proof of legal existence; verify SIREN/SIRET and APE code alignment with ISIC 3240; apply for VAT identification (FR TVA number); open the definitive corporate bank account; and complete social security (URSSAF/SSI) and employer registrations where personnel are hired.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract of the newly registered company
Statuts as registered
Identity documents of the Gérant and major shareholders
Final corporate bank account details
VAT and social security registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the APE code is rejected as inconsistent with the corporate purpose, request rectification from INSEE through the Greffe; if VAT allocation is pending, use the K-bis extract or provisional registration acknowledgment as interim evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) and the Préfecture, with DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement) for ICPE matters where thresholds are met.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Déclaration d'ouverture de l'établissement artisanal/industriel (micro-atelier de découpe laser) and, where applicable, a Certificat de non-classement or Déclaration ICPE under Articles R.513-1 and R.512-47 of the Environmental Code; laser safety equipment file (Class 4 laser) for the Labor Inspectorate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique – DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a small-batch wooden puzzle workshop with typical CO2 laser power ≤ 150 W, the installation is generally below ICPE classification thresholds and is covered by a Préfecture-issued certificate of non-classification; if processing power rises to declared thresholds, the simple 'Déclaration ICPE' regime applies, with full EIA (étude d'impact) required only at the 'Autorisation' threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Workplace air: occupational exposure limit for inhalable wood dust 1 mg/m³ (Labor Code Article R.4222-10). Laser fumes: extraction and HEPA/activated-carbon filtration must keep VOC and particulate emissions below applicable thresholds. Wastewater: trade effluent into municipal sewer must comply with pH 5.5–8.5, total suspended solids ≤ 35 mg/L, and COD ≤ 125 mg/L. Waste: wood offcuts, ash and used filters must be removed by licensed carriers under bordereau de suivi de déchets and stored to avoid fire hazard.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: inspection by SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours) validating emergency exits, extinguishers, and separation of the laser station from combustible materials. Building clearance: déclaration préalable de travaux or occupancy permit from the Mairie confirming load-bearing capacity. Occupational clearance: Labor Inspectorate authorization for Class 4 laser operation, work-station medical aptitude checks, electrical installation conformity certificate (CONSUEL), and installation of emergency stop and airflow-monitoring devices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique, France; internet portal: impots.gouv.fr; company registration and statutory formalities via the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; customs and export-side authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), portal: douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Standard operating procedure for a French-established SARL: (1) File the incorporation dossier through the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) under Ordinance No. 2021-1389 of 27 October 2021 (in force since 1 January 2023); INSEE issues the 9-digit SIREN and 14-digit SIRET identifiers within approximately 3 to 5 working days and automatically transmits the file to DGFiP. (2) The statutory declaration of existence triggers VAT identification; DGFiP issues the intra-Community VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire) in the format FR + 2-digit key + 11-digit SIREN, under Article 286-I of the Code Général des Impôts (CGI); the number appears on the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) extract and is verifiable on the EU VIES database. (3) For business activities falling below the Article 293 B CGI small-business franchise thresholds, the SARL may claim the franchise, but any direct or marketplace-mediated sale of goods normally justifies full VAT registration; the franchise is waivable at the taxpayer's option. (4) Register with DGDDI to obtain the French EORI number (format FR + SIREN), mandatory for any customs export declaration. (5) For distance sales of goods to consumers in other EU Member States, enroll in the OSS (One-Stop-Shop) module through the DGFiP professional online portal. Non-resident companies not established in France are required instead to appoint a tax representative (représentant fiscal) accredited by DGFiP; this requirement does not apply to the resident FR_SARL.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not operate a US-style check-the-box election; the following statutory elections exist: (a) under Article 239 bis AA CGI, a newly created SARL/EURL satisfying SME criteria (not more than 50 employees and turnover or balance sheet total not exceeding €10 million) may opt, within the first 3 months of its first fiscal year, for income-tax transparency (régime des sociétés de personnes) for a maximum of 5 fiscal years, after which it reverts mandatorily to corporate income tax (IS); (b) under Article 8 CGI, a SARL de famille may elect income-tax transparency at shareholder level; (c) under Article 239 CGI, partnerships may opt for corporate income tax; (d) EU anti-hybrid and reverse-hybrid rules (Directives (EU) 2016/1164 and 2017/952) apply mandatorily and cannot be circumvented by elective classification; (e) under Article 209 I CGI, the territoriality principle allows exclusion of foreign permanent-establishment profits from the French IS base, while Article 209 quinquies CGI permits an election for worldwide taxation. The default regime for a standard commercial SARL remains entity-level French IS at the standard rate of 25%, with the reduced 15% rate applicable to the first €42,500 of annual taxable profit for small businesses, plus the local territorial economic contribution (CET: CFE + CVAE) depending on the plant and turnover profile.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: TVA (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée) — Council Directive 2006/112/EC transposed into the French Code Général des Impôts, Articles 256 to 283 quinquies CGI; administered by DGFiP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no minimum turnover threshold for mandatory VAT registration of a French-established SARL; any taxable person carrying out an economic activity in France must file a declaration of existence (Article 286-I CGI). The small-business exemption (franchise en base de TVA, Article 293 B CGI) applies up to €85,000 per calendar year for sales of goods and €37,500 for supplies of services, with upper override thresholds of €93,500 (goods) and €41,000 (services); however, the franchise is not applicable to intra-Community distance sales declared through the OSS and is, in commercial practice, incompatible with marketplace-mediated consumer sales where the platform or payment facilitator (Amazon Pay, Stripe) requires evidence of VAT registration. A fully registered SARL selling manufactured wooden puzzles under ISIC 3240 / NAF 32.40Z will therefore collect French VAT at 20% on domestic B2C sales and will be required to file periodic CA3 VAT returns.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (B2B domestic) and e-reporting (B2C and cross-border) under the French Finance Act 2023 and the implementing decrees of 2024: from 1 September 2026 all large and mid-sized enterprises must issue and receive structured electronic invoices (EN 16931 formats: Factur-X, UBL, CII) through DGFiP-registered dematerialization platforms (PDP) or partner dematerialization platforms (PPD); from 1 September 2027 the mandate extends to small and micro enterprises, including the FR_SARL tier. B2C transactions settled through Amazon Pay or Stripe are subject to e-reporting: transaction data must be transmitted by the accredited PDP to DGFiP no later than the next working day after issuance. France does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance system with digital stamping in the style of the Italian SDI; instead, the DGFiP relies on structured data exchange through registered platforms, with open REST/SOAP APIs and the mandatory DSR (Données de facturation et de transaction) data model. The administration will progressively pre-fill VAT returns from the transmitted e-invoice and e-reporting data while the periodic CA3/CA12 filing obligation remains in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to destinations outside the European Union are zero-rated under Article 262-I-1° CGI provided the removal is physically accomplished and the exporter holds evidential proof prior to the VAT return deadline and upon audit request; services directly connected to exported goods (freight, handling, customs representation) are exempt under Article 262-I-2° CGI. For intra-Community supplies (B2B), the exemption under Article 262-I-3° CGI requires the customer's valid VAT identification number and the submission of EC Sales Lists; the supplier must dispatch the goods to another Member State. Distance sales of goods to EU final consumers do not qualify for export zero-rating: they are taxable in the Member State of arrival, with the intra-EU distance sales threshold of €10,000 per year and the optional OSS scheme applying. Where Amazon operates as marketplace or FBA provider, the platform may be treated as deemed supplier (Article 283 CGI implementing Article 14a of Directive 2006/112/EC); genuine third-country exports require actual customs exit and the exporter retains the burden of proof. Input VAT on costs attributable to genuine exports remains recoverable under Article 271 CGI and no refund procedure is required for the resident exporter.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Déclaration d'exportation DAU / Single Administrative Document) validated by DGDDI with a valid MRN (Movement Reference Number) evidencing the definitive exit from EU customs territory
Transport document: Bill of Lading (B/L) for sea freight, CMR waybill for road freight, or Air Waybill (LTA IATA) showing the routing to the third-country destination
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the CN8/HS commodity code, weight, value, and beneficiary of the export
Inward remittance certificate (attestation bancaire de rapatriement des devises / SWIFT MT103 credit advice) demonstrating effective collection of export proceeds in the seller's bank account
EORI certificate and VAT registration extract to align the customs declarant with the DGFiP tax file
Intrastat DEB (déclaration d'échange de biens) for intra-EU dispatches where the annual dispatch threshold (€460,000 as of 2025) is exceeded
Retained export dossier (preuve d'exportation) with all underlying transport and insurance documents kept for at least 6 years for audit purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French customs and tax administrations apply strict documentary scrutiny to export zero-rating. Missing, inconsistent, or retrospectively invalid export proof triggers reassessment of the 20% VAT on the export price, together with late-payment interest (intérêt de retard) at 0.20% per month (Article 1727 CGI) and penalty surcharges: 40% for bad faith (mauvaise foi, Article 1729-b CGI) or 80% for fraudulent maneuvers (manœuvres frauduleuses, Article 1729-c CGI). Goods covered by a false export declaration may be seized under the Customs Code (Articles 414 and 423), with fines proportional to the value and potential confiscation. The ordinary reassessment window is three fiscal years from the filing date, extended to six years for fraud or undisclosed activity; deliberate evasion is prosecutable under Article 1741 CGI. In practice, DGFiP and DGDDI examiners verify that export proceeds are collected within a 180-day benchmark and that payment evidence matches the declared foreign counterparty; the absence of FX repatriation proof is a recurring trigger for clawback at 20% plus 40% penalties. For commerce flowing through Amazon Pay or Stripe, the audit file must reconcile payment-facilitator settlement reports with the corresponding export declarations, delivery proofs, and the underlying customer orders.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), operating within the Eurosystem and the European System of Central Banks (ESCB); it exercises balance-of-payments statistics collection, foreign-exchange data oversight and macroprudential supervision jointly with the ACPR (Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority) and the French General Directorate of the Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) for capital-movement authorisations and foreign-investment screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies the complete free movement of capital regime under Articles 63-65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU), transposed into Articles L151-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier - CMF). The euro is fully convertible on both current-account and capital-account transactions; there is no general foreign-exchange restriction, no surrender obligation and no executive authorisation requirement for ordinary inbound equity or shareholder debt. Non-EU foreign direct investment (FDI) is screened only in sensitive sectors (defence, security, dual-use, critical technologies and critical infrastructure) under Decree No. 2019-1590 as amended by Decree No. 2021-1404; laser-cutting of wooden educational puzzles (ISIC 3240) is outside that perimeter. Profit remittance by the SARL to non-resident shareholders is lawful without licence; dividend distributions are subject to French withholding tax (25% for non-resident corporate shareholders; 30% flat tax for natural persons comprising 12.8% income tax plus 17.2% social levies), reduced to 0% for eligible EU/EEA corporate shareholders under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, and to applicable tax-treaty rates for US, UK, Chinese or other non-EU shareholders. Practical remittance hurdles are documentary: the paying bank requires a French tax-residence certificate for the SARL and an up-to-date beneficial-owner declaration before any dividend wire is released.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender, repatriation deadline or mandatory conversion ratio for French export proceeds. Exporters freely retain EUR or foreign currency abroad or in local accounts; the only obligations are statistical reporting of cross-border flows by the intermediary bank under CMF Articles R154-1 et seq. and the EU cash-control declaration for cash movements across EU borders exceeding EUR 10,000. Transfers to or from States listed by France as non-cooperative jurisdictions (ETNC) trigger prior declaration or Treasury authorisation under CMF Articles L151-3 and L511-41-5 and will be rejected by compliant banks absent clearance. Export deliveries and intra-EU dispatches benefit from VAT zero-rating under Article 262-I of the French General Tax Code (CGI); the SARL must maintain customs and transport evidence (CN23, EX-A/EX-T, bills of lading, delivery receipts) to substantiate the zero rate and to answer any bank query on the underlying trade purpose.

Operational Account (Compte Professionnel) plus EUR/USD dual-currency treasury module

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: MEDIUM-HIGH as the operational settlement rail, LOW as the sole treasury vault. Qonto, Shine (Société Générale subsidiary) and Wise Business are ACPR-regulated payment or electronic-money institutions able to issue French business IBANs to an SARL via eIDAS electronic signature, K-bis extract, UBO declaration and director ID. They support SEPA Credit Transfer, SWIFT MT103 receipt, virtual IBANs and integrations with Stripe and Amazon marketplace payouts, with onboarding in 1-3 business days versus 3-8 weeks for clearing banks. Legal constraints: (i) EMIs cannot grant credit, overdrafts, repo or FX-line facilities; (ii) client funds are safeguarded by segregation rather than covered by the French Deposit Guarantee Scheme (FGDR) in the same manner as deposits; (iii) inbound capital injections from non-EU shareholders above approximately EUR 50,000 are likely to be paused for enhanced KYC and may require final settlement through a Tier-1 bank; (iv) EMIs do not execute EMIR-reportable FX hedging. Recommended dual-rail posture: Qonto for operational disbursements, marketplace fee payments and SaaS expenses, with BNP Paribas or Société Générale as the clearing pivot for capital injections, large trade settlements and hedging lines.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a statutory physical-branch visit; remote onboarding is permitted under CMF Article L561-5 through video identification and eIDAS-qualified electronic signatures, consistent with ACPR digital onboarding guidance. In practice, major clearing banks treat an SARL with a sole non-French gérant as complex-risk and will require at least one video welcome interview in English or French plus notarised or apostilled certified copies of the statutes and K-bis. Where the bank's internal policy mandates face-to-face interaction, only a physical visit to a Paris, Lyon or Aix-en-Provence branch unlocks the account; directors cannot unilaterally waive that policy. To maximise remote success, the SARL should appoint a French-resident gérant or a signing officer with French identification and prepare the complete package in advance: certified K-bis extract not older than three months, statuts, shareholder resolution authorising account opening, UBO forms, six months of source-of-funds evidence and the underlying purchase and supply contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO (bénéficiaire effectif) declaration gap - indirect holding chain through a foreign SPV or trust, or stale RCS filing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official Form M-S 3231 as stamped by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; complete corporate organigram with percentage ownership; passport copies of each natural-person UBO; proof of residence issued within three months; tax residence certificate (W-8BEN-E or Certificate of Residence) for foreign UBOs; signed gérant letter confirming no omitted indirect shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained capital injection from a non-EU founder exceeding EUR 50,000, or originating from a FATF/ETNC watch-listed jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month personal or business bank statements of the funding shareholder; capital subscription minutes and funding schedule; accountant-certified balance sheet of the founder; evidence of salary credits or asset-liquidation proceeds; signed Source-of-Wealth statement under CMF Article L561-6; tax clearance certificates from the founder's country of residence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening hit on a director or UBO - EU/UN/OFAC/FATF name-match or politically exposed person designation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative-match confirmation from the EU Sanctions Map and licensed screening tools dated within 72 hours of account opening; notarised questionnaire confirming no beneficial interest in political functions; statutory auditor or chartered accountant reference; full identity documents and signed declaration of assets and beneficial interests; false-positive analysis memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial counterparty mismatch - incoming or outgoing payments from an unrelated sector or from an ETNC-listed country to a wooden-puzzle manufacturer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial agreements (purchase orders, invoices, delivery notes); CO2 laser-cutting work orders describing SKUs under ISIC 3240 / NAICS 339930; customs evidence (bill of lading, EUR.1 movement certificate, CN23/EX-A); official registry extract (K-bis or equivalent) of the counterparty; structured memorandum demonstrating the Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement chain and the real economic link.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Treasury pattern anomalies - marketplace payouts blended with high refunds, round-trip FX flashing, or card-interchange masking of sales proceeds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Seller Central and Stripe dashboard settlement reports for the preceding six months; daily debit/credit ledger with reconciliation; product cost and MSRP analysis; documented refund policy and provisioning schedule; card-network reports proving online marketplace sales rather than money remittance; liquidity policy memo reserving three months of operating costs and defining mandatory manual review for any single flow above EUR 25,000.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Free-flow routing applies: EU/EEA shareholders transfer EUR via SEPA Credit Transfer with purpose code EQUI or LOAN, requiring no French clearance; the receiving bank files the balance-of-payments declaration to Banque de France automatically. Non-EU shareholders route via SWIFT MT103 through a correspondent chain (CITI or JPMorgan London/New York) into the SARL's EUR IBAN, using purpose code S131 for FDI exceeding 10% of voting rights or S231 for long-term shareholder loans; the beneficiary bank performs automatic BoP statistical reporting. For USD-denominated injections, conversion to EUR is executed at the receiving French bank's spot rate on value date; filed field 72 must include the narrative 'INVEST/S131' together with the capital subscription resolution (procès-verbal), share register and transfer certificate. Transfers originating from an ETNC jurisdiction require prior authorisation under CMF Articles L151-3 and L511-41-5 and are otherwise refused. SEPA credits settle T+1 and SWIFT credits typically T+2; the SARL must maintain a liquidity buffer of at least three months of operating expenses in EUR to absorb settlement delays or correspondent-bank holds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing-rail matrix: (1) EU suppliers and operating expenses - native SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001) to supplier IBAN with settlement T+0/T+1; VAT element recorded separately. (2) Marketplace fees and refunds via Amazon Pay and Stripe - native SEPA CT referencing the marketplace settlement ID. (3) UK or Swiss suppliers - SWIFT MT103 for single payments or MT202COV for cover payments to the supplier's correspondent; charges shared (field 71A SHA). (4) Asian raw-material suppliers (MDF, acrylic, laser tubes mainly from China/Taiwan) - SWIFT MT103 for amounts below USD 50,000; irrevocable Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) or documentary collection (D/P, D/A) for larger consignments; French issuing bank completes field 45A with 'CNC/CO2 laser-cut parts for educational wooden puzzles (ISIC 3240)' and field 46A with commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill and inspection certificate. (5) Amazon and Stripe inbound settlements arrive as SEPA CT after D+3 to D+7 cycles; a refund reserve equal to 1.5-3% of gross sales must be maintained. Dual approval is enforced for any single outbound flow above EUR 25,000, followed by automated reconciliation against the trade or marketplace invoice number.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD OTC spot and outright forward contracts (1-12 month tenors) with BNP Paribas or Société Générale under an ISDA/FBF master agreement; permitted for hedge-only purposes as a non-financial counterparty (NFC) without an ACPR product licence; no EMIR clearing obligation below the NFC clearing threshold, but EMIR Article 9 trade-repository reporting remains mandatory.
EUR/GBP and EUR/CHF forward outrights to hedge London marketplace fees and Swiss raw-material invoices.

EUR/CNH forward or offshore Chinese yuan (CNH) non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing the CNY fixing, executed with an EU-authorised bank to hedge import invoices from Chinese suppliers on the basis of open trade exposure.
EUR/USD foreign-exchange swap (swap de change) to cover short-term working-capital mismatches between EUR marketplace receipts and USD import payables.

Cross-currency interest-rate swap (CCIRS) applicable when a shareholder loan is denominated in USD or CHF while operating EBITDA is EUR-denominated; permitted as a Class 3 derivative with EMIR reporting obligations assessed under the NFC- status.

Bought EUR/USD vanilla options (premium paid upfront, no margin-line requirement) used exclusively to protect budgeted conversion of projected Amazon USD payouts; written or sold options are not permissible under the SARL's treasury mandate.
